rationale: Story s13 (the binding-key pending map and the event-proportional settle) reads and moves pending-row counts and the generation through IndexState, owned by s1: its settle promotes and re-classes pending rows (completing awaiting-target rows, writing external and unbindable classes) and must keep IndexState's counts true in the same transaction.
